verdict.rationale: Identity Verification integrates with a separate product, Monitor, to check users against watchlists and PEP lists (plaid-idv-docs-13, plaid-idv-docs-10). IDV webhooks exist, but the documented events (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED) cover session progress, not watchlist changes (plaid-idv-docs-3, plaid-idv-docs-25). Nothing in the pack shows that verified users are re-screened as watchlists change. Missing for 10: evidence of ongoing re-screening of previously verified users against watchlist updates, documented watchlist-hit or change events/webhooks to act on, documentation of how this works within IDV rather than only via the separate Monitor product, independent corroboration.
